_doc: Recipe overrides written by dev/gen_recipe_overrides.py into kubejs/data/<ns>/recipe/. 'why' names the reason in 'reasons'; 'from' is the jar whose file the override replaces. Regenerate with python dev/gen_recipe_overrides.py, check with --check.

reasons.typeless-removal: The mod removes this recipe with a file that has no type; KubeJS warned 'not a json object' at every data load. Same removal with a type: KubeJS skips it at DEBUG.
reasons.pack-removes: KubeJS could not read the mod's old format ('Falling back to vanilla'), and the pack removes the recipe anyway (see the entry's note); removed before KubeJS reads it.
reasons.missing-item: The recipe names an item that does not exist in this pack (see the entry's note); it failed to load on every data load and is removed before KubeJS reads it.
reasons.old-format: Create 0.5 format that Create 6 still loads but KubeJS cannot read ('Falling back to vanilla'); rewritten in Create 6.0.10's own format, same recipe.
reasons.over-stack: The recipe makes more than the item's stack size; it loaded at boot but every later data load (/reload, /firmages ages sync) rejected it with 'larger than maximum'. Same recipe, count at the stack size.
reasons.wrong-tag: The recipe names a tag that does not exist, so its ingredient was empty and the recipe could not be crafted; KubeJS warned 'not allowed to be empty'. Points to the tag the mod meant.
